correctness.rationale: Under the stated strong-product confusability rule, any row with two codewords forbids its adjacent rows and bounds the remaining adjacent pair by two, hence any size-five independent set meets every row once. Successive second coordinates differ by ±2; summing all five circular increments forces all signs identical modulo 5. Therefore the only maxima are five translations of each slope ±2. They form one orbit under the 200-element natural channel-isometry group; orbit-stabilizer gives size 20. Fresh independent brute force enumerated all 53,130 five-subsets and all 177,100 six-subsets of the 25-word channel, found exactly 10 maximum sets and no size-six code, and matched affine constructions. The finite census here is exhaustive for the exact finite instance, not an infinite capacity proof.

evidence: Shannon 1956 introduced pentagon two-use construction; Lovász capacity covers asymptotic and maximum-size constraints; neither mathematical consequence specifies the ten labeled maxima.
